info.name: Facebook iOS 27 Liquid Glass
info.description:
Transform Facebook with an ultra-sleek Apple VisionOS & iOS 27 Glassmorphism theme! Features deep backdrop blurs, floating feed cards, SF Pro typography, pill-style search inputs, and smooth spring physics hover animations.

✨ Key Features:
• Glassmorphic UI with dynamic backdrop blur & ambient lighting
• Pill-shaped header search bar & rounded action elements
• Floating Feed Cards with spring physics hover dynamics
• Translucent chat tabs and drop-down menus
• Custom iOS-inspired smooth scrollbar

⚠️ Requirement: Enable Facebook native Dark Mode for the optimal glass glow experience.
info.additionalInfo:
? Version 1.0.0 Release Notes:
- Initial release of Facebook iOS 27 Liquid Glassmorphism design.
- Built using high-stability attribute selectors (role/data-pagelet) to ensure layout resilience against Facebook updates.

Instructions:
- Works best with Facebook native Dark Mode enabled.
- Fully compatible with Stylus and Stylish browser extensions.
